title: Untouched cluster reports as shut
description: A cluster that has never had its band geometry modified returns the default BAND_SHUT state.
given: empty geometry map and a cluster id
when: bandGeometry is called with that cluster id
then: it returns BAND_SHUT (collapsed: true, maximized: false)
